# commands

<!-- generated by scripts/docs/build_site.py from the code; do not edit by hand -->

Every command of `stratarc`, generated from the command line parser so the page cannot drift from the code. Run `python3 scripts/docs/build_site.py --check` to confirm it still matches.

## global-options

Global options are accepted before or after the command.

| option | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--root` `PATH` | the source root (sets STRATARC_SOURCE) |
| `--home` `PATH` | the home directory the runtime targets hang under (sets STRATARC_HOME) |
| `--projects-root` `PATH` | the directory that holds project checkouts (sets LLM_ROOT_PROJECTS_DIR) |
| `--owner` `NAME` | the GitHub owner whose repositories are managed (sets STRATARC_GITHUB_OWNER) |
| `--json` | print one JSON envelope instead of text |
| `--debug` | print a traceback when a command stops unexpectedly |

## exit-statuses

| status | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | failure: the command ran and did not succeed |
| 2 | invalid input: a bad argument, an unknown source root, an invalid `stratarc.toml`, or a refusal by the engine |
| 3 | denied: the home is missing or not writable |
| 4 | conflict: the target already holds something |
| 5 | unavailable: a packaged resource is missing, a file in the home is newer than this stratarc, a provider did not answer, an adapter does not support the installed runtime, or the change log database is locked |
| 6 | drift: the deployed files differ from what the source renders |
| 130 | interrupted |

## init

scaffold a new source root into TARGET.

```text
stratarc init target
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `target` | Directory to create; must be absent or empty. |

## doctor

report the health of the install, the home and the source root.

```text
stratarc doctor [--permissions] [--clean] [--yes] [--report]
```

| option | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--permissions` | Also print what each command reads and writes. |
| `--clean` | Also list the old backups and cache the home can shed. |
| `--yes` | With --clean, remove what it lists. |
| `--report` | Also write a redacted bundle for an issue report under state/debug. |

## sync

render the source into every enabled runtime and managed project.

```text
stratarc sync [{apply}] [--verify] [--rollback-on-drift] [--only RUNTIME] [--allow-branch BRANCH] [--dry-run] [--list]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `verb` | Apply is the same as no verb. One of `apply`. |

| option | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--verify` | After the write, verify the change against what is deployed; exit 6 on drift. |
| `--rollback-on-drift` | When verification finds drift, restore the runtime files from the home backups (implies --verify). |
| `--only` `RUNTIME` | Sync one runtime and skip project delivery. |
| `--allow-branch` `BRANCH` | Deploy from this branch too. Repeatable. |
| `--dry-run` | Print what a sync would change and write nothing. |
| `--list` | List the runtimes and whether each target exists. |

## check

report what is out of date, write nothing, exit 6 on drift.

```text

```

| option | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--only` `RUNTIME` |  |
| `--allow-branch` `BRANCH` | Repeatable. |

## config

show the resolved settings and where each value came from.

```text
stratarc config {get,list,explain} [--project P] [--agent A] [--account X] [--runtime R] [--set KEY=VALUE] [--set-json KEY=JSON] [--set-mode KEY=MODE]
```

| option | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--project` `P` |  |
| `--agent` `A` |  |
| `--account` `X` |  |
| `--runtime` `R` |  |
| `--set` `KEY=VALUE` | Set a key to a literal string in the flags layer (repeatable). |
| `--set-json` `KEY=JSON` | Set a key to a JSON value in the flags layer (repeatable). |
| `--set-mode` `KEY=MODE` | Replace or extend, for a --set-json list that redefines a list. Repeatable. |

### config-get

print the resolved value of a key.

```text
stratarc config get key
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `key` |  |

### config-list

print every resolved key.

```text
stratarc config list
```

### config-explain

print the resolution chain for a key.

```text
stratarc config explain [key] [--tree]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `key` |  |

| option | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--tree` | Print the inheritance outline for --project. |

## log


| `--project` `VALUE` |  |
| `--file` `VALUE` |  |
| `--layer` `VALUE` |  |
| `--key` `VALUE` |  |
| `--actor-kind` `VALUE` |  |
| `--actor` `VALUE` |  |
| `--command` `VALUE` |  |

| `--since` `VALUE` |  |
| `--until` `VALUE` |  |

### log-enable

turn the database and JSONL log on.

```text
stratarc log enable
```

### log-disable

turn the database and JSONL log off; the human log stays on.

```text

```

### log-prune


| --- | --- |
| `--before` `YYYY-MM-DD` |  |
| `--dry-run` |  |

## verify

check that what the source says is what is deployed.

```text
stratarc verify {run,last,show}
```

### verify-run

re-render and compare with what is deployed.

```text
stratarc verify run [--scope SCOPE] [--verbose]
```

| option | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--scope` `SCOPE` | All, project:<name> or change:<id>. |
| `--verbose` | List verified files too. |

### verify-last

the most recent report.

```text
stratarc verify last [--verbose]
```

| option | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--verbose` |  |

### verify-show

one report by id.

```text
stratarc verify show [id] [--verbose]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `id` |  |

| option | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--verbose` |  |
